page_title: TOU 1-1 REI | Toulouse v Reims 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 5053' Toulouse score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

90+4' Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Yehvann Diouf leaps like a salmon to deny him.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A free kick into the box, taken by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Denis Genreau (Toulouse) coming on for Cristian Casseres.
88' A dangerous looking corner kick from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is cleared to safety by the defence.

88' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. Toulouse will take a corner kick.
87' Frank Magri (Toulouse) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Yehvann Diouf.
85' Joseph Okumu (Reims) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
85' Junya Ito (Reims) will take a corner kick.
83' The substitution has been made. Amadou Kone (Reims) has replaced Amir Richardson.
83' Good movement by Ibrahim Diakite (Reims), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
81' The resulting corner from Frank Magri (Toulouse) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
79' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Reda Khadra (Reims) comes onto the pitch for Valentin Atangana Edoa.
77' The substitution is prepared. Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thomas Foket.
77' William Still has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Diakite (Reims) replaces Thibault De Smet.
76' Substitution. Thijs Dallinga did his best and is replaced by Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse).
76' Substitution. Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) in, Gabriel Suazo out.
74' Toulouse are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
66' Here is a change. Cesar Gelabert Pina is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Frank Magri (Toulouse).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aron Donnum leaves the pitch and Mamady Bangre (Toulouse) comes on.
66' One of the Toulouse players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
64' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
63' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Junya Ito (Reims).
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aron Donnum (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' William Still prepares a substitution. Mohamed Daramy is replaced by Oumar Diakite (Reims).
59' Logan Costa (Toulouse) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' Junya Ito (Reims) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
51' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Toulouse players have a reason to celebrate!
51' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
51' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
48' 0 - 1 Amir Richardson (Reims) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Guillaume Restes. 0:1.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' PENALTY APPEAL after Mohamed Daramy (Reims) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45+2' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45+1' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
41' Joseph Okumu (Reims) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' A quickly taken corner by Toulouse.
36' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jeremy Stinat who sees an offensive foul. A free kick is awarded to Reims.
34' Joseph Okumu (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' 1:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
26' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
23' Thibault De Smet (Reims) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
22' Joseph Okumu (Reims) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Junya Ito, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
21' Thibault De Smet (Reims) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

19' Toulouse slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
14' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) swings it in and Thijs Dallinga gets on the end of it, but Yehvann Diouf shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.

14' What a chance that is! Junya Ito (Reims) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post!
10' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.

9' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims). He steered the ball towards the left post, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
9' Corner kick. Junya Ito (Reims) is ready to send the ball into the box.
9' Junya Ito (Reims) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.
7' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
4' Thomas Foket (Reims) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
3' Junya Ito (Reims) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
3' Thomas Foket (Reims) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Reims.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Reims will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat is the one to supervise the game today.
